name: Pollo Guisado (Latin Braised Chicken)
ingredients_verbatim: 2-1/2 pound chicken cut up, skin on
1 small bell pepper chopped (or use hotter peppers to your taste)
FOR GARNISH: Spicy chili flakes fresh chopped parsley
why: Classic Latin bone-in braised chicken (browned, then simmered in sofrito/tomato/broth); a stew the catalog does not have yet despite its deep Latin-stew shelf. Published nutrition 451 cal / 28 g protein / 26 g carbs per serving lands squarely in-band (400-650 cal, <=35 g carbs) at the low-mid. Bone-in skin-on cut chicken (whole-chicken / thighs class), no seafood. Every main ingredient maps to the board (adobo-seasoning, sazon-seasoning, sofrito-cooking-base, green-olives, russet-potatoes, onions, bell-peppers, garlic, tomato-sauce, chicken-broth), so it scales cleanly to 14 servings with weigh-and-divide.
